summary: Compute the model’s bare and RPA susceptibilities, then compare leading singlet and triplet pairing eigenvalues and gap functions at the specified temperature.
limits: Origin remains model; no material validation or material Tc is implied.
Before calculation, verify the Hamiltonian is real, Hermitian, single-orbital, spin-independent and SOC-free; assume a paramagnetic state.
Use the supplied chemical potential directly, not as a target filling.
Construct the noninteracting Green function and bare susceptibility, then Hubbard RPA spin/charge susceptibilities and linearized singlet/triplet pairing kernels following the cited TPRF formulation.
Stop the paramagnetic RPA route if a magnetic instability is reached.
An eigenvalue below one is a valid negative result at this temperature.
Use the specified mesh and 150 positive Matsubara frequencies; numerical convergence remains unverified.
This is a plan only; no calculation or numerical result is reported.
